messages:
Rina M: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands runtime segment — can we get a one-paragraph summary for PMs about adaptive batching and microbatching?
Gabe T: Short: microbatching = pack nearby requests within batch_window_ms (default 10ms) to improve GPU utilization; expected ~8-12% p50 win on text-gen. Adaptive batching will adjust that window by observed seq-length distribution to avoid p95 blowups.
Jules (kernel): Note: attention-fuse v5 is in canary but the 4-bit quant path has a correctness edge-case. Kernel fallback keeps behavior correct but reduces throughput ~4%. We're gating full roll by fixing that path.
Rina M: Product specifically asked if customers need to flip any flags. Answer?
Gabe T: No breaking flags. We will expose an opt-in route config: {"adaptive_batching": true} for alpha. Defaults unchanged.
Sam K: infra question: what alerts should SRE add for canary?
Jules (kernel): Add p95 increase >7% sustained for 30m and KV cache hit-rate drop >10% relative baseline. infra-bot create alert ticket?
infra-bot: Created alert RNW-3102: canary-adaptive-batch-p95 and RNW-3103: canary-kv-hit-drop.
Rina M: Can someone draft the release-note blurb? Two bullets: benefits and potential regressions + how to opt-in.
Gabe T: I'll draft and open a docs PR tonight; will paste in this thread.
Jules (kernel): Also adding ticket RNW-3110: adaptive-window-prototype (est 4d). Will update when assigned.
Rina M: Thanks all — please post perf numbers once the perf job runs and I'll consolidate for PMs.
